tables.name: Table 4 — Release specification
tables.markdown:
| Category | Test | Method | Acceptance criteria — DS | Acceptance criteria — DP |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Identity | Peptide map | LC-MS peptide mapping | Conforms to reference standard | Conforms to reference standard |
| Identity | Charge profile | icIEF | Profile comparable to reference standard | Profile comparable to reference standard |
| Quantity | Protein content | UV A280 | 150 ± 15 mg/mL | 150 mg/vial ± 10% (reconstituted) |
| Purity | Monomer | SEC-HPLC | ≥ 97.0% | ≥ 97.0% |
| Purity | High molecular weight species | SEC-HPLC | ≤ 2.0% | ≤ 2.0% |
| Purity | Purity, non-reduced | CE-SDS (NR) | Main peak ≥ 95.0% | Main peak ≥ 95.0% |
| Purity | Purity, reduced | CE-SDS (R) | HC + LC ≥ 97.0% | HC + LC ≥ 97.0% |
| Purity | Charge variants | icIEF | Main 55–75%; acidic ≤ 30%; basic ≤ 15% | Main 55–75%; acidic ≤ 30%; basic ≤ 15% |
| Potency | Biological activity | Cell-based reporter assay | 70–130% of reference standard | 70–130% of reference standard |
| Potency | Target binding | ELISA | 80–125% of reference standard | 80–125% of reference standard |
| Process impurities | Host cell protein | HCP ELISA | ≤ 100 ng/mg | Not tested |
| Process impurities | Residual host cell DNA | qPCR | ≤ 10 pg/mg | Not tested |
| Process impurities | Leached Protein A | ELISA | ≤ 10 ng/mg | Not tested |
| Safety | Bacterial endotoxins | LAL kinetic chromogenic (USP <85>) | ≤ 0.5 EU/mg | ≤ 0.3 EU/mg |
| Safety | Bioburden | Membrane filtration (USP <61>) | ≤ 10 CFU/10 mL | N/A |
| Safety | Sterility | Membrane filtration (USP <71>) | N/A | Sterile |
| Safety | Mycoplasma (unprocessed bulk) | qPCR (Ph. Eur. 2.6.7) | Not detected | N/A |
| General | Appearance | Visual | Clear to slightly opalescent, colourless to slightly yellow | White to off-white lyophilized cake |
| General | pH | Potentiometry (USP <791>) | 6.0 ± 0.3 | 6.0 ± 0.3 |
| General | Osmolality | Freezing-point depression | 270–330 mOsm/kg | 270–330 mOsm/kg |
| General | Polysorbate 80 | HPLC-CAD | 0.01–0.03% (w/v) | 0.01–0.03% (w/v) |
| DP only | Water content | Karl Fischer (coulometric) | N/A | ≤ 2.0% |
| DP only | Reconstitution time | Visual, 1.2 mL WFI | N/A | ≤ 5 min |
| DP only | Visible particles | Visual inspection (USP <790>) | N/A | Practically free from particles |
| DP only | Subvisible particles | Light obscuration (USP <788>) | N/A | ≥ 10 µm: ≤ 6,000/container; ≥ 25 µm: ≤ 600/container |
| DP only | Container closure integrity | Helium leak / HVLD | N/A | Pass |
